other_conditions: Must purchase 12 dairy animals (cows or buffaloes).
Must establish a new dairy farm.
Must have ownership, inheritance, or leasehold rights over the land (lease minimum 7 years if not owned).
Must obtain a loan from a Reserve Bank‑recognized institution or bank.
benefits_summary: Provides interest subsidy (up to 8.5%) and various capital subsidies for shed construction, animal insurance, and equipment, with higher rates for SC/ST/female beneficiaries and Gir/Kankrej breeds.
